chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, who said:

I said to al-Rida عليه السلام, "Inform me about the Imam: when does he know that he is an Imam—when news reaches him that his companion has passed away, or when he actually passes away? For example, Abu al-Hasan was taken in Baghdad while you are here?"
He عليه السلام said, "He knows that when his companion passes away."
I said, "By what means?" He عليه السلام said, "Allah inspires him."

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the source of this inspired knowledge
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the divinely appointed Imam being asked about in the narration
key_terms.صَاحِبَهُ: his predecessor, meaning the previous Imam
key_terms.مَضَى: passed away or departed from this world
key_terms.يُلْهِمُهُ: He inspires him, meaning Allah grants him direct inspiration

ai.seo_question: When does the Imam know that the Imamate has come to him?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the Imam knows the transfer of the Imamate at the very moment the previous Imam passes away, not merely when news of the death reaches him. It further states that this knowledge comes through divine inspiration from Allah, highlighting the special divine connection of the Imam.
